en: Moo's magical bell, once upon a time, in a peaceful farm nestled between rolling emerald
zh: 穆的魔法鈴鐺，從前，在一個坐落於翠綠起伏山丘間的寧靜農場裡，
ja: ムーの魔法の鈴、昔々、緑の丘に囲まれた平和な農場に、
local: Moo's magical bell, once upon a time, in a peaceful farm nestled between rolling emerald
ja_pron: Mū no mahō no suzu, mukashi mukashi, midori no oka ni kakomareta heiwa na nōjō ni
native: Moo's magical bell, once upon a time, in a peaceful farm nestled between rolling emerald

en: hills, lived a kind and curious cow named Moo.
zh: 住著一隻善良又好奇的牛，名叫穆。
ja: 丘に、親切で好奇心旺盛な牛のムーが住んでいました。
local: hills, lived a kind and curious cow named Moo.
ja_pron: Oka ni, shinsetsu de kōkishin ōseina ushi no Mū ga sunde imashita.
native: hills, lived a kind and curious cow named Moo.

en: Moo had big, gentle eyes, a golden coat, and the sweetest heart.
zh: 穆有著大而溫柔的眼睛、金色的毛皮和最甜美的心靈。
ja: ムーは大きくて優しい目、黄金色の毛皮、そして一番優しい心を持っていました。
local: Moo had big, gentle eyes, a golden coat, and the sweetest heart.
ja_pron: Mū wa ōkikute yasashii me, ōgon-iro no kegawa, soshite ichiban yasashii kokoro o motte imashita.
native: Moo had big, gentle eyes, a golden coat, and the sweetest heart.

en: She loved her friends dearly, but she had one secret wish.
zh: 她非常愛她的朋友們，但她有一個秘密願望。
ja: 彼女は友達をとても大切にしていましたが、ひとつ秘密の願いがありました。
local: She loved her friends dearly, but she had one secret wish.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa tomodachi o totemo taisetsu ni shite imashita ga, hitotsu himitsu no negai ga arimashita.
native: She loved her friends dearly, but she had one secret wish.

en: She wore an old rusty bell around her neck, clink, clink, it went.
zh: 她脖子上戴著一個舊而生鏽的鈴鐺，叮噹叮噹地響著。
ja: 彼女は首に古くて錆びた鈴をつけていて、チリンチリンと鳴っていました。
local: She wore an old rusty bell around her neck, clink, clink, it went.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa kubi ni furukute sabita suzu o tsukete ite, chirin chirin to natte imashita.
native: She wore an old rusty bell around her neck, clink, clink, it went.

en: His old bell is so boring, Moo sighed one sunny morning.
zh: 他的舊鈴鐺真無聊，穆在一個晴朗的早晨嘆氣道。
ja: 彼の古い鈴はとても退屈だと、ムーは晴れた朝にため息をつきました。
local: His old bell is so boring, Moo sighed one sunny morning.
ja_pron: Kare no furui suzu wa totemo taikutsu da to, Mū wa hareta asa ni tameiki o tsukimashita.
native: His old bell is so boring, Moo sighed one sunny morning.

en: If only it were magical, imagine the wonderful things I could do.
zh: 如果它是魔法鈴，想像我能做多麼美妙的事情。
ja: もしこれが魔法の鈴だったら、どんな素敵なことができるか想像してみて。
local: If only it were magical, imagine the wonderful things I could do.
ja_pron: Moshi kore ga mahō no suzu dattara, donna suteki na koto ga dekiru ka sōzō shite mite.
native: If only it were magical, imagine the wonderful things I could do.

en: Suddenly, a joyful chime echoed in the air.
zh: 突然，一聲歡快的鈴聲在空中迴盪。
ja: 突然、楽しい鈴の音が空気に響き渡りました。
local: Suddenly, a joyful chime echoed in the air.
ja_pron: Totsuzen, tanoshii suzu no oto ga kūki ni hibiki watarimashita.
native: Suddenly, a joyful chime echoed in the air.

en: Moo's rusty bell began to shimmer and glow with bright golden light, a tiny fairy with
zh: 穆的生鏽鈴鐺開始閃爍並發出明亮的金色光芒，一位擁有閃亮水晶翅膀的小仙子出現了。
ja: ムーの錆びた鈴が輝き始め、明るい黄金色の光を放ち、小さな妖精が現れました。
local: Moo's rusty bell began to shimmer and glow with bright golden light, a tiny fairy with
ja_pron: Mū no sabita suzu ga kagayaki hajime, akarui ōgon-iro no hikari o hanachi, chiisana yōsei ga arawaremashita.
native: Moo's rusty bell began to shimmer and glow with bright golden light, a tiny fairy with

en: sparkling crystal wings appeared.
zh: 閃閃發光的水晶翅膀出現了。
ja: きらめくクリスタルの翼を持つ妖精が現れました。
local: sparkling crystal wings appeared.
ja_pron: Kirameku kurisutaru no tsubasa o motsu yōsei ga arawaremashita.
native: sparkling crystal wings appeared.

en: Treatings Moo, the fairy cheered, because you are so kind and full of wonderful dreams,
zh: 仙子對穆說，因為你如此善良且充滿美好的夢想，
ja: ムーに言いました、あなたはとても優しく素敵な夢でいっぱいだから、
local: Treatings Moo, the fairy cheered, because you are so kind and full of wonderful dreams,
ja_pron: Mū ni iimashita, anata wa totemo yasashiku suteki na yume de ippai dakara,
native: Treatings Moo, the fairy cheered, because you are so kind and full of wonderful dreams,

en: I have a special gift for you.
zh: 我有一份特別的禮物給你。
ja: あなたに特別な贈り物があります。
local: I have a special gift for you.
ja_pron: Anata ni tokubetsu na okurimono ga arimasu.
native: I have a special gift for you.

en: This bell is now magic.
zh: 這個鈴鐺現在是魔法鈴。
ja: この鈴は今や魔法の鈴です。
local: This bell is now magic.
ja_pron: Kono suzu wa imaya mahō no suzu desu.
native: This bell is now magic.

en: Ring it once, and any wish will be granted.
zh: 搖響一次，任何願望都會實現。
ja: 一度鳴らせば、どんな願いも叶います。
local: Ring it once, and any wish will be granted.
ja_pron: Ichido naraseba, donna negai mo kanaimasu.
native: Ring it once, and any wish will be granted.

en: But remember, magic is powerful.
zh: 但請記住，魔法是強大的。
ja: しかし覚えていてください、魔法は強力です。
local: But remember, magic is powerful.
ja_pron: Shikashi oboete ite kudasai, mahō wa kyōryoku desu.
native: But remember, magic is powerful.

en: Use it wisely.
zh: 要明智地使用它。
ja: 賢く使いなさい。
local: Use it wisely.
ja_pron: Kashikoku tsukainasai.
native: Use it wisely.

en: As the fairy vanished, Moo danced with excitement.
zh: 當仙子消失時，穆興奮地跳起舞來。
ja: 妖精が消えると、ムーは興奮して踊りました。
local: As the fairy vanished, Moo danced with excitement.
ja_pron: Yōsei ga kieru to, Mū wa kōfun shite odorimashita.
native: As the fairy vanished, Moo danced with excitement.

en: She shook her bell and said, I wish for the tastiest, yummiest grass in the whole wide
zh: 她搖了搖鈴鐺說，我希望有全世界最好吃、最美味的草，
ja: 彼女は鈴を振って言いました、世界で一番美味しい草を願います、
local: She shook her bell and said, I wish for the tastiest, yummiest grass in the whole wide
ja_pron: Kanojo wa suzu o futte iimashita, sekai de ichiban oishii kusa o negaimasu,
native: She shook her bell and said, I wish for the tastiest, yummiest grass in the whole wide

en: world.
zh: 全世界。
ja: 世界中の。
local: world.
ja_pron: Sekaijū no.
native: world.

en: Jingle, instantly, the ordinary grass transformed into lush, juicy, emerald grass.
zh: 叮噹，瞬間，普通的草變成了茂盛多汁的翡翠綠草。
ja: チリン、瞬く間に普通の草が青々としたジューシーなエメラルドグリーンの草に変わりました。
local: Jingle, instantly, the ordinary grass transformed into lush, juicy, emerald grass.
ja_pron: Chirin, matatakuma ni futsū no kusa ga aoao to shita jūshī na emerarudo gurīn no kusa ni kawarimashita.
native: Jingle, instantly, the ordinary grass transformed into lush, juicy, emerald grass.

en: Moo took a bite.
zh: 穆咬了一口。
ja: ムーは一口かじりました。
local: Moo took a bite.
ja_pron: Mū wa hitokuchi kajirimashita.
native: Moo took a bite.

en: Mmm, this is grass-tastic.
zh: 嗯，這草真棒。
ja: うーん、これは草の素晴らしさだ。
local: Mmm, this is grass-tastic.
ja_pron: Ūn, kore wa kusa no subarashisa da.
native: Mmm, this is grass-tastic.

en: The next morning, Moo saw her friend, cheeky the squirrel, looking incredibly sad.
zh: 隔天早晨，穆看到她的朋友，調皮的松鼠，看起來非常難過。
ja: 翌朝、ムーは友達のいたずらリスのチーキーがとても悲しそうにしているのを見ました。
local: The next morning, Moo saw her friend, cheeky the squirrel, looking incredibly sad.
ja_pron: Yokuasa, Mū wa tomodachi no itazura risu no Chīkī ga totemo kanashisō ni shite iru no o mimashita.
native: The next morning, Moo saw her friend, cheeky the squirrel, looking incredibly sad.

en: All the acorns I saved for winter are gone, cheeky sniffled.
zh: 我為冬天存的所有橡實都不見了，調皮抽泣著說。
ja: 冬のために取っておいたドングリが全部なくなったと、チーキーはすすり泣きました。
local: All the acorns I saved for winter are gone, cheeky sniffled.
ja_pron: Fuyu no tame ni totte oita donguri ga zenbu nakunatta to, Chīkī wa susurinakimashita.
native: All the acorns I saved for winter are gone, cheeky sniffled.

en: What am I going to eat?
zh: 我要吃什麼呢？
ja: 何を食べればいいんだろう？
local: What am I going to eat?
ja_pron: Nani o tabereba īndarō?
native: What am I going to eat?

en: Moo's kind heart couldn't stand seeing her friend upset.
zh: 穆善良的心無法忍受看到朋友難過。
ja: ムーの優しい心は、友達が悲しんでいるのを見るのが耐えられませんでした。
local: Moo's kind heart couldn't stand seeing her friend upset.
ja_pron: Mū no yasashii kokoro wa, tomodachi ga kanashinde iru no o miru no ga taeraremasen deshita.
native: Moo's kind heart couldn't stand seeing her friend upset.

en: She shook her magic bell.
zh: 她搖了搖她的魔法鈴。
ja: 彼女は魔法の鈴を振りました。
local: She shook her magic bell.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa mahō no suzu o furimashita.
native: She shook her magic bell.

en: I wish for a massive pile of acorns for cheeky.
zh: 我希望調皮有一大堆橡實。
ja: チーキーのために大量のドングリを願います。
local: I wish for a massive pile of acorns for cheeky.
ja_pron: Chīkī no tame ni tairyo no donguri o negaimasu.
native: I wish for a massive pile of acorns for cheeky.

en: Jingle, acorns rained down, creating a giant, delicious mountain, cheeky jumped for joy.
zh: 叮噹，橡實如雨般落下，堆成一座巨大美味的山，調皮高興地跳了起來。
ja: チリン、ドングリが雨のように降り注ぎ、巨大で美味しい山ができ、チーキーは喜んで跳びはねました。
local: Jingle, acorns rained down, creating a giant, delicious mountain, cheeky jumped for joy.
ja_pron: Chirin, donguri ga ame no yō ni furisosogi, kyodai de oishii yama ga deki, Chīkī wa yorokonde tobinahamemashita.
native: Jingle, acorns rained down, creating a giant, delicious mountain, cheeky jumped for joy.

en: Moo realized something important, helping her friends felt even better than making a wish
zh: 穆意識到一件重要的事，幫助朋友比許願還要讓人感覺更好，
ja: ムーは大切なことに気づきました。友達を助けることは、自分の願いを叶えるよりも素晴らしいと感じました。
local: Moo realized something important, helping her friends felt even better than making a wish
ja_pron: Mū wa taisetsu na koto ni kizukimashita. Tomodachi o tasukeru koto wa, jibun no negai o kanaeru yori mo subarashii to kanjimashita.
native: Moo realized something important, helping her friends felt even better than making a wish

en: for herself.
zh: 為自己許願還要更好。
ja: 自分のために願うよりも。
local: for herself.
ja_pron: Jibun no tame ni negau yori mo.
native: for herself.

en: Later, Moo found Dooku, the duck, and her chicks, crying beside a dried-up pond.
zh: 後來，穆發現鴨子杜庫和她的小鴨子們在乾涸的池塘旁哭泣。
ja: その後、ムーはアヒルのドゥークとそのヒナたちが干上がった池のそばで泣いているのを見つけました。
local: Later, Moo found Dooku, the duck, and her chicks, crying beside a dried-up pond.
ja_pron: Sonogo, Mū wa ahiru no Dūku to sono hinatachi ga hiagatta ike no soba de naite iru no o mitsukemashita.
native: Later, Moo found Dooku, the duck, and her chicks, crying beside a dried-up pond.

en: Do not worry, my feathered friends, Moo said, she rang her bell.
zh: 別擔心，我的羽毛朋友們，穆說著，搖響了她的鈴。
ja: 心配しないで、羽の友達たちよ、とムーは言い、鈴を鳴らしました。
local: Do not worry, my feathered friends, Moo said, she rang her bell.
ja_pron: Shinpai shinaide, hane no tomodachi-tachi yo, to Mū wa ii, suzu o narashimashita.
native: Do not worry, my feathered friends, Moo said, she rang her bell.

en: I wish for a cool, sparkling pond.
zh: 我希望有一個涼爽閃亮的池塘。
ja: 涼しくてきらめく池を願います。
local: I wish for a cool, sparkling pond.
ja_pron: Suzushikute kirameku ike o negaimasu.
native: I wish for a cool, sparkling pond.

en: Water burst from the ground, and the ducks happily dove in.
zh: 水從地面湧出，鴨子們快樂地跳入水中。
ja: 水が地面から湧き出し、アヒルたちは嬉しそうに飛び込みました。
local: Water burst from the ground, and the ducks happily dove in.
ja_pron: Mizu ga jimen kara wakidashi, ahiru-tachi wa ureshisō ni tobikomimashita.
native: Water burst from the ground, and the ducks happily dove in.

en: Next, Moo gave Rusty the old dog a giant leafy tree for shade, and created a soft bed
zh: 接著，穆給了老狗拉斯蒂一棵巨大的樹蔭，並為疲憊的農場馬匹創造了一張柔軟的乾草床，
ja: 次に、ムーは老犬ラスティに大きな葉の木を日陰として与え、疲れた農場の馬たちのために柔らかい干し草のベッドを作りました。
local: Next, Moo gave Rusty the old dog a giant leafy tree for shade, and created a soft bed
ja_pron: Tsugi ni, Mū wa rōken Rasuti ni ōkina ha no ki o hikage to shite ata e, tsukareta nōjō no uma-tachi no tame ni yawarakai hoshikusa no beddo o tsukurimashita.
native: Next, Moo gave Rusty the old dog a giant leafy tree for shade, and created a soft bed

en: of golden hay for the tired farm horses.
zh: 為疲憊的農場馬匹準備了金黃色的乾草床。
ja: 疲れた農場の馬たちのために黄金色の干し草のベッドを作りました。
local: of golden hay for the tired farm horses.
ja_pron: Tsukareta nōjō no uma-tachi no tame ni ōgon-iro no hoshikusa no beddo o tsukurimashita.
native: of golden hay for the tired farm horses.

en: Moo had discovered the greatest magic of all, the joy of giving.
zh: 穆發現了最偉大的魔法，那就是給予的喜悅。
ja: ムーは最高の魔法、与える喜びを発見しました。
local: Moo had discovered the greatest magic of all, the joy of giving.
ja_pron: Mū wa saikō no mahō, ataeru yorokobi o hakken shimashita.
native: Moo had discovered the greatest magic of all, the joy of giving.

en: However, sneaky, clucky the rooster was watching.
zh: 然而，狡猾的公雞克拉基正在偷看著。
ja: しかし、ずる賢い雄鶏のクラッキーが見ていました。
local: However, sneaky, clucky the rooster was watching.
ja_pron: Shikashi, zuru-gashikoi ondori no Kurakkī ga mite imashita.
native: However, sneaky, clucky the rooster was watching.

en: Why should Moo have all the fun?
zh: 為什麼穆應該擁有所有的樂趣？
ja: なぜムーだけが楽しむべきなの？
local: Why should Moo have all the fun?
ja_pron: Naze Mū dake ga tanoshimu beki na no?
native: Why should Moo have all the fun?

en: He muttered, while Moo was napping, clucky grabbed the bell.
zh: 他嘀咕著，當穆在午睡時，克拉基搶走了鈴鐺。
ja: 彼はつぶやきました。ムーが昼寝をしている間に、クラッキーは鈴を掴みました。
local: He muttered, while Moo was napping, clucky grabbed the bell.
ja_pron: Kare wa tsubuyakimashita. Mū ga hirune o shite iru aida ni, Kurakkī wa suzu o tsukamimashita.
native: He muttered, while Moo was napping, clucky grabbed the bell.

en: I wish for the biggest cornfield in the world, just for me.
zh: 我希望擁有世界上最大的玉米田，只屬於我。
ja: 世界で一番大きなトウモロコシ畑を、私だけのために願います。
local: I wish for the biggest cornfield in the world, just for me.
ja_pron: Sekai de ichiban ōkina tōmorokoshi batake o, watashi dake no tame ni negaimasu.
native: I wish for the biggest cornfield in the world, just for me.

en: Boom!
zh: 轟！
ja: ドーン！
local: Boom!
ja_pron: Dōn!
native: Boom!

en: The gentle meadows and the barn vanished.
zh: 溫柔的草地和穀倉消失了。
ja: 穏やかな牧草地と納屋が消えました。
local: The gentle meadows and the barn vanished.
ja_pron: Odayaka na bokusōchi to naya ga kiemashita.
native: The gentle meadows and the barn vanished.

en: The entire farm turned into an endless sea of towering thick cornstocks.
zh: 整個農場變成了無盡的高大濃密玉米田海洋。
ja: 農場全体が果てしない高くて密集したトウモロコシ畑の海に変わりました。
local: The entire farm turned into an endless sea of towering thick cornstocks.
ja_pron: Nōjō zentai ga hateshinai takakute misshū shita tōmorokoshi batake no umi ni kawarimashita.
native: The entire farm turned into an endless sea of towering thick cornstocks.

en: I am the king of corn, clucky crowed, but soon chaos struck.
zh: 我是玉米之王，克拉基啼叫，但很快混亂發生了。
ja: 私はトウモロコシの王様だとクラッキーは鳴きましたが、すぐに混乱が起きました。
local: I am the king of corn, clucky crowed, but soon chaos struck.
ja_pron: Watashi wa tōmorokoshi no ōsama da to Kurakkī wa nakimashita ga, sugu ni konran ga okimashita.
native: I am the king of corn, clucky crowed, but soon chaos struck.

en: The sheep bumped into the thick stalks, and clucky got completely lost.
zh: 綿羊撞上了濃密的莖，克拉基完全迷路了。
ja: 羊たちは太い茎にぶつかり、クラッキーは完全に迷子になりました。
local: The sheep bumped into the thick stalks, and clucky got completely lost.
ja_pron: Hitsuji-tachi wa futoi kuki ni butsukari, Kurakkī wa kanzen ni maigo ni narimashita.
native: The sheep bumped into the thick stalks, and clucky got completely lost.

en: Wait, this is too much corn, he panicked.
zh: 等等，這太多玉米了，他慌了。
ja: 待って、これはトウモロコシが多すぎる、と彼は慌てました。
local: Wait, this is too much corn, he panicked.
ja_pron: Matte, kore wa tōmorokoshi ga ōsugiru, to kare wa awatemashita.
native: Wait, this is too much corn, he panicked.

en: Moo woke up and found him, clucky handed the bell back in shame.
zh: 穆醒來找到他，克拉基羞愧地把鈴鐺還了回來。
ja: ムーは目を覚まし彼を見つけ、クラッキーは恥ずかしそうに鈴を返しました。
local: Moo woke up and found him, clucky handed the bell back in shame.
ja_pron: Mū wa me o samashi kare o mitsuke, Kurakkī wa hazukashisō ni suzu o kaeshimashita.
native: Moo woke up and found him, clucky handed the bell back in shame.

en: Moo shook it one last time.
zh: 穆最後搖了搖鈴。
ja: ムーは最後にもう一度鈴を振りました。
local: Moo shook it one last time.
ja_pron: Mū wa saigo ni mō ichido suzu o furimashita.
native: Moo shook it one last time.

en: I wish for our farm to go back to normal.
zh: 我希望我們的農場恢復正常。
ja: 私たちの農場が元に戻ることを願います。
local: I wish for our farm to go back to normal.
ja_pron: Watashitachi no nōjō ga moto ni modoru koto o negaimasu.
native: I wish for our farm to go back to normal.

en: Woosh!
zh: 呼！
ja: シュッ！
local: Woosh!
ja_pron: Shu!
native: Woosh!

en: A golden light swept away the cornstocks.
zh: 一道金光掃除了玉米莖。
ja: 黄金の光がトウモロコシの茎を一掃しました。
local: A golden light swept away the cornstocks.
ja_pron: Ōgon no hikari ga tōmorokoshi no kuki o issō shimashita.
native: A golden light swept away the cornstocks.

en: The barn reappeared, and everything was perfect once more.
zh: 穀倉重新出現，一切又恢復完美。
ja: 納屋が再び現れ、すべてが再び完璧になりました。
local: The barn reappeared, and everything was perfect once more.
ja_pron: Naya ga futatabi araware, subete ga futatabi kanpeki ni narimashita.
native: The barn reappeared, and everything was perfect once more.

en: I am so sorry, Moo, clucky apologized.
zh: 對不起，穆，克拉基道歉了。
ja: ごめんなさい、ムー、とクラッキーは謝りました。
local: I am so sorry, Moo, clucky apologized.
ja_pron: Gomen nasai, Mū, to Kurakkī wa ayamarimashita.
native: I am so sorry, Moo, clucky apologized.

en: It's okay, clucky.
zh: 沒關係，克拉基。
ja: 大丈夫だよ、クラッキー。
local: It's okay, clucky.
ja_pron: Daijōbu da yo, Kurakkī.
native: It's okay, clucky.

en: Moo smiled.
zh: 穆微笑了。
ja: ムーは微笑みました。
local: Moo smiled.
ja_pron: Mū wa hohoemimashita.
native: Moo smiled.

en: Just remember, too much of a good thing isn't always good at all.
zh: 只要記住，過猶不及。
ja: ただ覚えていてください、良いこともやりすぎると良くないことがあります。
local: Just remember, too much of a good thing isn't always good at all.
ja_pron: Tada oboete ite kudasai, yoi koto mo yarisugiru to yokunai koto ga arimasu.
native: Just remember, too much of a good thing isn't always good at all.

en: As the sun set, the glowing fairy reappeared.
zh: 夕陽西下，發光的仙子再次出現。
ja: 夕日が沈むと、輝く妖精が再び現れました。
local: As the sun set, the glowing fairy reappeared.
ja_pron: Yūhi ga shizumu to, kagayaku yōsei ga futatabi arawaremashita.
native: As the sun set, the glowing fairy reappeared.

en: Moo, you used your magic incredibly well.
zh: 穆，你用魔法用得非常好。
ja: ムー、あなたは魔法をとても上手に使いました。
local: Moo, you used your magic incredibly well.
ja_pron: Mū, anata wa mahō o totemo jōzu ni tsukaimashita.
native: Moo, you used your magic incredibly well.

en: Your kind heart is the greatest magic of all.
zh: 你善良的心是最偉大的魔法。
ja: あなたの優しい心こそが最高の魔法です。
local: Your kind heart is the greatest magic of all.
ja_pron: Anata no yasashii kokoro koso ga saikō no mahō desu.
native: Your kind heart is the greatest magic of all.

en: The bell will no longer grant wishes, but it will always ring to remind you of the beauty
zh: 鈴鐺將不再實現願望，但它會永遠響起，提醒你善良的美麗。
ja: 鈴はもう願いを叶えませんが、いつも鳴って優しさの美しさを思い出させてくれます。
local: The bell will no longer grant wishes, but it will always ring to remind you of the beauty
ja_pron: Suzu wa mō negai o kanaemasen ga, itsumo natte yasashisa no utsukushisa o omoidasasete kuremasu.
native: The bell will no longer grant wishes, but it will always ring to remind you of the beauty

en: of kindness.
zh: 善良的美麗。
ja: 優しさの美しさを。
local: of kindness.
ja_pron: Yasashisa no utsukushisa o.
native: of kindness.

en: The fairy faded away.
zh: 仙子消失了。
ja: 妖精は消えていきました。
local: The fairy faded away.
ja_pron: Yōsei wa kiete ikimashita.
native: The fairy faded away.

en: Moo walked happily across the meadow, her bell jingling a sweet, peaceful melody, reminding
zh: 穆快樂地走過草地，她的鈴鐺叮噹作響，奏出甜美和平靜的旋律，提醒著
ja: ムーは幸せそうに草原を歩き、鈴が甘く穏やかなメロディーを鳴らし、思い出させました。
local: Moo walked happily across the meadow, her bell jingling a sweet, peaceful melody, reminding
ja_pron: Mū wa shiawase sō ni sōgen o aruki, suzu ga amaku odayaka na merodī o narashi, omoidasasemashita.
native: Moo walked happily across the meadow, her bell jingling a sweet, peaceful melody, reminding

en: everyone that the real magic in life is helping those you love.
zh: 每個人，生命中真正的魔法是幫助你所愛的人。
ja: みんなに、人生の本当の魔法は愛する人を助けることだと。
local: everyone that the real magic in life is helping those you love.
ja_pron: Min'na ni, jinsei no hontō no mahō wa aisuru hito o tasukeru koto da to.
native: everyone that the real magic in life is helping those you love.

en: Did you enjoy Moo's magical adventure?
zh: 你喜歡穆的魔法冒險嗎？
ja: ムーの魔法の冒険は楽しめましたか？
local: Did you enjoy Moo's magical adventure?
ja_pron: Mū no mahō no bōken wa tanoshimemashita ka?
native: Did you enjoy Moo's magical adventure?

en: If you loved this story about kindness, please give this video a huge thumbs up.
zh: 如果你喜歡這個關於善良的故事，請給這個影片一個大大的讚。
ja: この優しさの物語が気に入ったら、この動画に大きないいねをお願いします。
local: If you loved this story about kindness, please give this video a huge thumbs up.
ja_pron: Kono yasashisa no monogatari ga ki ni ittara, kono dōga ni ōkina ī ne o onegaishimasu.
native: If you loved this story about kindness, please give this video a huge thumbs up.

en: Share it with your friends and hit that subscribe button for more wonderful stories.
zh: 與你的朋友分享，並按下訂閱按鈕，獲取更多精彩故事。
ja: 友達と共有して、もっと素敵な物語のために登録ボタンを押してください。
local: Share it with your friends and hit that subscribe button for more wonderful stories.
ja_pron: Tomodachi to kyōyū shite, motto suteki na monogatari no tame ni tōroku botan o oshite kudasai.
native: Share it with your friends and hit that subscribe button for more wonderful stories.

en: Let us know in the comments what you would wish for.
zh: 在留言區告訴我們你會許什麼願望。
ja: コメントであなたの願い事を教えてください。
local: Let us know in the comments what you would wish for.
ja_pron: Komento de anata no negaigoto o oshiete kudasai.
native: Let us know in the comments what you would wish for.

en: See you next time!
zh: 下次見！
ja: また次回お会いしましょう！
local: See you next time!
ja_pron: Mata jikai o ai shimashō!
native: See you next time!
